newsitem.title: USA: Pena names Energy Department aides.
newsitem.headline: Pena names Energy Department aides.

text.p: Energy Secretary Federico Pena, sworn in Wednesday, named Elgie Holstein to be his chief of staff, a senior Energy Department official said Thursday.
Holstein was chosen from the White House's National Economic Council where he worked on energy-related issues.
Pena also named four senior advisors: John Angell, Dan Reicher, Kyle Simpson, and Tom Vellenga, and selected Brooke Anderson to be director of public affairs, Simpson said.
Angell and Vellenga were senior advisors to ex-White House chief of staff Leon Panetta.
Simpson was associate deputy energy secretary for fossil energy, and Reicher was chief of staff to former Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary.
Brooke Anderson was press secretary to Rep. David Skaggs, a Colorado Republican.
Charles Curtis, who was acting secretary, remains as deputy secretary. But he said earlier this week that after Pena was sworn in he would "figure out what to do."
